snippet.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — The Story So Far
snippet.description:
Whether The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Complete Edition is your first foray into the story of Geralt of Rivia, or you could simply use a refresher on the events that led him to this point, Geralt’s trusty mare Roach has got you covered with this quick recap of the story so far.
